faq.title: Everything you need to feel certain.
faq.description: Still wondering about a product or payment method? A real support specialist is always close.

items.question: How quickly will my order arrive?
items.answer: Automatic products usually arrive in seconds. Every product shows an honest delivery estimate before checkout, and manual services include a visible SLA.

items.question: Which payment methods can I use in Lebanon?
items.answer: You can use Nexora Wallet, Whish Money, OMT, Visa or Mastercard, supported crypto networks, bank transfer, and approved cash flows.

items.question: What happens if delivery fails?
items.answer: Our hybrid fulfillment automatically moves eligible failures to a staffed queue. If delivery cannot be completed, the order follows its protected refund policy.

items.question: Are gift-card codes and accounts guaranteed?
items.answer: Warranty terms are shown per product and variant. Verified codes are atomically assigned from private inventory and cannot be delivered twice.

items.question: Can I sell through Nexora?
items.answer: Yes. Resellers receive wholesale tiers, a dedicated dashboard, signed API access, sandbox mode, and delivery webhooks.
